title: Beat cuts
summary: Every beat of the music is a hard cut to a new shot with a punch that decays; the first beat of a bar hits harder in the accent.

params.name: format
params.description: output size; the layout recomposes for each

usage:
npx paper-motion add beat-cuts --name my-beat-cuts
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-beat-cuts/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-beat-cuts/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work) and, for the field, a shader-set entry.
Recomposes for 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1: set `format` and the layout and camera follow.
when: an edit that follows a track
